name: Hub Pro

steps.text: Connect the Hub to the internet and to a power outlet using the cables provided. Avoid switched outlets and filtered power strips.
On an iPhone or iPod touch with iCloud Keychain turned on, download Insteon+ from the App Store, allow it access to your HomeKit accessory data, and create an account or sign in.
Navigate to your home, tap the Add button in the upper right corner and tap Add a Device.
Tap Hub Pro at the bottom of the screen. It may take several minutes after connecting the Hub to power before it appears.
Enter the 8-digit Accessory Setup Code found on the bottom of the Hub, then give the Hub a name and pick an icon.

notes: Insteon+ requires a properly configured iCloud Keychain; if it is off or pending, the app cannot complete basic tasks like adding a device.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button.
While holding the SET button, reconnect the Hub to power.
Continue holding the SET button until the Hub stops beeping, then release it.

steps.expect: Hub double-beeps again; it has been restored to factory settings

notes: A factory reset also resets the HomeKit pairing, so the Hub can be added to a different HomeKit house.
Sold as a HomeKit bridge, which current versions of HomeKit no longer support.
Its hub interface on port 25105 is expected to match the other Hubs' but hasn't been verified.
Sold as the 2243-222 in the US, 2243-422 in Europe, 2243-442 in the UK and 2243-522 in Australia and New Zealand.
